review_candidates.description: Job Description: Type of Requisition: Regular Clearance Level Must Currently Possess: None Clearance Level Must Be Able To Obtain: None Public Trust/Other Required: None Job Family: IT Infrastructure and Operations Skills: Job Qualifications: High Performance Computing (HPC) Architecture, High-Performance Computing (HPC) Systems, Scientific Software Certifications: None Experience: 8 + years of related experience US Citizenship Required: No Job Description: We are seeking an HPC Administrator to join a Scientific Computing team supporting high-performance computing (HPC) and scientific research at NIAID. This role will provide local engineering support for HPC infrastructure and scientific software serving researchers, with strong emphasis on software installation, module support, systems troubleshooting, and scientific workflow enablement. Biomedical research activities for a major federal health agency depend on the technologies and services you’ll support in your role here at GDIT. Here, you’ll be empowered to turn obstacles into action. Join us on the frontlines of scientific computing services and make an impact on the health of our nation. This is a hybrid position located at Rocky Mountain Laboratories (RML), Hamilton, Montana. Onsite work will be required at least 1-2 times per month. Responsibilities: Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux-based HPC infrastructure, including compute nodes, login nodes, storage systems, and supporting services. Support the deployment, configuration, monitoring, and lifecycle management of HPC hardware, operating systems, and core infrastructure components. Assist with datacenter activities including hardware configuration, cabling, component replacement, and system validation during deployments and upgrades. Monitor system health, investigate performance issues, and help ensure the reliability, availability, and security of shared HPC resources. Support researchers utilizing Scientific workflows (such as CryoEM) by assisting with the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of CryoEM software applications and supporting HPC environments. Collaborate with researchers to help ensure reliable execution of data processing pipelines and to improve the performance and usability of their scientific workflows on shared HPC resources. Develop and maintain operational documentation, automation scripts, and standard procedures that improve the efficiency and reliability of HPC operations. Required Skills: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, scientific computing, bioinformatics, or a related field and at least 5 years of related experience. Experience working in Linux-based HPC or research computing environments Experience installing and supporting scientific software, compilers, and libraries Familiarity with job schedulers such as Slurm and supporting shared scientific workloads Experience supporting CryoEM software packages such as RELION, cryoSPARC, Imod or similar applications is highly desirable. Strong troubleshooting skills across software, environment, and user workflow issues Scripting experience in Bash, Python, or similar Familiarity with software build and package management tools such as Spack, EasyBuild etc Exposure to scientific applications and workflows used in research environments Experience with containers such as Apptainer/Singularity is a plus Ability to work closely with local stakeholders and provide dependable onsite support The likely salary range for this position is $88,130 - $115,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range. Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40 Travel Required: None Telecommuting Options: Hybrid Work Location: USA MT Hamilton Additional Work Locations: Total Rewards At GDIT: Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most. Our Identity Verification Process: As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes. About Our Work: We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. We operate across 50+ countries worldwide, offering leading mission-ready capabilities in AI, cloud, cyber and software development. Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on our career opportunities and events at gdit.com/tc. Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans

review_candidates.title: Enterprise Sales Representative
review_candidates.description: Our Purpose At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. About Us SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. What Are We Looking For? We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. As an Enterprise Sales Representative, you will accelerate SentinelOne's growth across large accounts in Saudi Arabia. You will manage complex, high-impact sales cycles and deliver cybersecurity solutions that create real, long-term value for your accounts. Combining strategic thinking with sharp execution, you will use MEDDICC to navigate complex organisations and align our technology to their most critical business and security priorities. What Will You Do? Primary responsibilities include: Develop and expand direct sales opportunities within strategic accounts across Saudi Arabia, targeting local state authorities, public health organisations, and critical infrastructure. Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders and senior decision-makers to drive sustainable growth. Lead complex sales cycles and present SentinelOne's cybersecurity solutions to C-level executives, supported by a dedicated sales engineer and channel partners. Drive growth through partner-led initiatives, including managed security services and strategic alliances, while collaborating with marketing and product teams on lead generation and go-to-market campaigns. Represent and champion SentinelOne's technology in the broader market, participate in key industry events, and consistently uphold sales excellence through best practices and operational discipline. What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring? Ideal candidates will have: Fluent written and spoken Arabic and English, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of an organization, including C-suite executives. 5+ years of consistent, above-quota sales success as a regional sales executive or manager, ideally selling enterprise or endpoint security solutions using MEDDICC or similar methodologies. Proven enterprise sales experience with an established network of senior decision-makers and a strong understanding of modern cybersecurity solutions and their business value. Demonstrated experience collaborating with channel partners and executing a channel-centric go-to-market approach, including managed security services and strategic alliances. Exceptional organizational, forecasting, and reporting abilities, combined with a driven, curious mindset and a "whatever it takes" attitude to achieve and exceed ambitious goals. Why SentinelOne? AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place. We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family: Time Off & Wellbeing Competitive leave benefits Gender-neutral parental leave Insurance & Financial Security Medical and insurance benefits Housing, education and transportation allowances Work Perks & Flexibility Global home office allowance Mobile phone allowance SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.
